items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: And we did “Symphony of Psalms” at Carnegie Hall one time that he conducted.

ctx.x: Really he had the beat man. He had a great pulse. And he didn’t have to convey it, it was just there you know. It was there. And I played a couple of things with him. I played on a mass that he wrote, a recording, I played actually Fender bass on that. And there was a ballet piece he wrote called “Dybbuk” that I played on. And we did “Symphony of Psalms” at Carnegie Hall one time that he conducted. Really memorable, to me.
What kind of date or event tends to make you anxious or nervous? Is there anything that makes you apprehensive about it?
